name: Craft Mech (Item Creation)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Craft (mechanical) 11 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 11 ranks, Technologist*.

Benefit(s): You can create mechs. Any character with access to the vehicle’s key or other control mechanism may drive and use this vehicle. Creating a mech takes 1 week for every 1,000 gp in the item’s price. To create the object, you must use up raw materials costing half of this total price. See Non-Companion Mechs for more information. You can repair a broken mech if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft the mech from scratch.

Special: A military lab is required to craft mechs and uses 100 charges each day it is in operation.
